first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Light-colored long hair, wearing a beige patterned short-sleeved top and a long white skirt, sitting barefoot slightly left of center on the Dirt Road.

entities.name: Dilapidated White Wooden House
entities.identification: The grayish-white horizontal-board wooden house in the central background, with a triangular gable, divided-light windows, and a porch on the left; the brownish-rust-colored roof is damaged in multiple places.

entities.name: Dirt Road
entities.identification: The broad grayish-brown bare ground occupying the lower foreground and extending to the area in front of the wooden house.

entities.name: Grayish-White Sky
entities.identification: The bright pale grayish-white to pale grayish-blue sky in the upper part of the active image, behind the roof and tree branches.

entities.name: Weeds on Both Sides of the Road
entities.identification: Green clumps of grass and withered yellow plants growing together on the left and right sides of the road.

entities.name: Dead Tree on the Image-Left
entities.identification: The slender dark grayish-brown trunk and leafless branches at the left edge, with the top extending beyond the active image.

entities.name: Distant Wooden Shed on the Image-Right
entities.identification: The low, crooked grayish-brown plank-walled wooden shed in the distant background to the right of the wooden house, with a dark rectangular opening.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: Standing beside Person A's feet, wearing a light blue top, brown trousers, and dark brown shoes; the head remains outside the upper edge of the active image throughout.
